'''Jerrod''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed at the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he was spying on Republic communications.
